# GrootAi — Enterprise Data Quality Intelligence Platform

GrootAi is a production-grade AI-powered data quality platform built for enterprise data stewardship.
It enables teams to define, enforce, and remediate data quality rules using natural language — with full human oversight and audit trails.

## Core Capabilities

- **Natural Language Rule Studio**: Express data quality rules in plain English; the Grounded AI Engine compiles them into deterministic, executable ASTs
- **Data Profiling**: Automated schema inference, completeness scoring, and anomaly detection across datasets
- **Issue Detection**: Rule-engine scans flag violations with row-level detail and issue tracking
- **AI-Assisted Remediation**: AI proposes data fixes for human review and approval — no auto-mutation without consent
- **Duplicate Detection**: Fuzzy matching and field-level similarity scoring to surface near-duplicate records
- **Audit Trail**: Every approve/reject/rollback is logged with actor, timestamp, and reason

## Technical Details

- Frontend: React 18 + Vite + Tailwind CSS, deployed on Vercel
- Backend: Node.js Express (ESM), deployed on Render
- Database: MongoDB Atlas
- AI Engine: Grounded deterministic AST parser (free, local) with optional Claude 3.5 Sonnet upgrade
- Auth: JWT (httpOnly cookie) + Google OAuth 2.0

## Usage Notes

- Guest users can view datasets, issues, and the Rule Studio in read-only mode
- Steward role required to approve or reject remediation proposals
- Admin role required for seeding data or running the eval suite
- The app is free to use — no API key required for the AI rule engine
